what: per country file of the store, per year, the fire detections its files hold

source.atlas: world-atlas 2.0.2, countries-50m.json, objects.countries, matched on properties.name

modis.what: fire rows (FIRMS type 0, day and night) of Terra and Aqua, as counted

viirs.what: fire rows (FIRMS type 0, day and night) of Suomi NPP, as counted

harmonized.what: the country's harmonized total on the Suomi NPP scale, from <world>/harmonize/years/

source.what: per country file of the store, per year, its fire rows (FIRMS type 0) on one scale: MODIS put on Suomi NPP's scale by the Record's served method, from the harmonized dataset as served
source.closed: in 2021 the cells that meet a test fire region's context box are left out of every series
source.years_note: 2000 holds November and December only; Suomi NPP's rows begin on 20 January 2012
source.shared_cells: a cell holding rows of two country files or more gives each its share of the cell's MODIS rows in a month MODIS saw rows, and its share of the cell's Suomi NPP rows over every month (or of all its rows where Suomi NPP has none) in a month MODIS saw nothing; the shares of a cell sum to one, so the countries sum to the world and, by their continents (the Russian Federation cut at 60 E by each cell's centre), to the continents of totals.json

values: one per year of `years`; null before the series' first year (or where the harmonized file gives none), 0 in a year with no row

closed.rule: the cells the closed rule closes (cells meeting a test fire's region's context box, in the years of its fire) are left out of every country's total, as the yearly layers leave them out
